# Whistle.day

> Free tournament organiser: draw a bracket, group stage or Swiss tournament,
> run the day from a phone, and put live scores on a projector or TV. No
> account required to start, no ads, no caps. Also reachable by an AI agent
> over MCP — the same tools the web app's own screens are built on.

Whistle.day supports round robin, single elimination, double elimination and
Swiss formats, in any order (a group stage feeding a playoff, for example).
Results entered from a phone at the court propagate to tables, brackets and
projector screens in under a second. Every tournament gets a shareable link
and a QR code; no signup is required until an organiser wants to keep it.

## Agents

- [MCP server](https://whistle.day/mcp): Point Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP
  client at `https://whistle.day/api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, no account
  needed) and an agent can create a tournament, add teams and courts, draw a
  stage, score matches, and hand back a link and a QR code — the same 21
  tools the web app's own screens use.

## Formats

- [Tournament generator](https://whistle.day/tournament-generator): the hub —
  pick a format by how much of a day you have, not by what it's called.
- [Round robin generator](https://whistle.day/round-robin-generator): every
  team plays every other; groups feed into a playoff.
- [Single elimination bracket generator](https://whistle.day/single-elimination-bracket-generator):
  lose once and you're out.
- [Double elimination bracket generator](https://whistle.day/double-elimination-bracket-generator):
  a losers bracket gives everyone a second chance.
- [Swiss tournament generator](https://whistle.day/swiss-tournament-generator):
  pairings by record, no elimination, every team plays every round.
- [Group stage and knockout generator](https://whistle.day/group-stage-knockout-generator):
  pools then a playoff.
- [League table generator](https://whistle.day/league-table-generator):
  standings with tiebreakers explained.
- [Multi-stage tournament builder](https://whistle.day/multi-stage-tournament-builder):
  chain formats in any order.

## Running the day

- [Run a tournament from your phone](https://whistle.day/run-a-tournament-from-your-phone):
  set up, schedule and score a whole tournament with no laptop and no account.
- [Tournament projector display](https://whistle.day/tournament-projector-display):
  live scores, tables and the bracket on a screen in the hall, self-rotating.
- [Live tournament standings screen](https://whistle.day/live-tournament-standings-screen):
  group tables and league standings, rebuilt after every result.
- [Tournament bracket on a TV](https://whistle.day/tournament-bracket-on-a-tv):
  a bracket that fills itself in as results come in.
- [QR code tournament results](https://whistle.day/qr-code-tournament-results):
  a QR code that opens live results on a spectator's phone.
- [Referee scoring app](https://whistle.day/referee-scoring-app): each referee
  scores their own court from their own phone.
- [Multi-court tournament scheduler](https://whistle.day/multi-court-tournament-scheduler):
  assign matches to courts and times and catch clashes before they happen.
